scientific_integrity: An elementary finite-recursion proof and an exhaustive 16-by-16 comparison underlie the all-parameter claim; numerical tests support, do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the five offsets 0,1,4,9,16, and a>=34; no classification of arbitrary square-offset lengths. The exact law fails at 33. Independent review not performed; unindexed equivalents possible.
title: Exact pseudo-Frobenius spectra for five shifted-square generators
